# Portal de Periódicos UFPB

> Open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals, conference proceedings, and student research from Universidade Federal da Paraíba.

The Portal de Periódicos UFPB is the central hub for scholarly publications from Brazil's Federal University of Paraíba, featuring interdisciplinary journals in humanities, linguistics, semiotics, and social sciences. The platform emphasizes open access, inclusion, and accessibility while supporting undergraduate research initiatives and academic conferences.

## Key Topics

- open-access publishing
- academic journals
- conference proceedings
- UFPB (Universidade Federal da Paraíba)

## Main Portal & Navigation

- [Portal de Periódicos UFPB](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/capa/periodicos.php): Main portal showcasing UFPB's academic journals and open-access publications

## Peer-Reviewed Journals

- [Acta Semiótica et Lingvistica](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/actas): International peer-reviewed journal on semiotics and linguistics from UFPB
- [v. 28 n. 2 (47): SEMIÓTICA E LINGVÍSTICA](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/actas/issue/current): Current issue of Acta Semiótica et Lingvistica journal on semiotics

## Research & Scientific Initiation

- [Revista de Iniciação Científica - PROPESQ-UFPB](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/enic): UFPB's scientific initiation journal featuring award-winning undergraduate research
- [v. 29 (2023): Série Iniciados - Trabalhos Premiados](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/enic/issue/current): Volume 29 of award-winning scientific initiation papers from UFPB 2023

## Conference Proceedings & Special Issues

- [Congresso de Inclusão e Acessibilidade](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/cia): Conference proceedings for UFPB's Congress on Inclusion and Accessibility
- [v. 2 (2025): Anais do III Congresso de Inclusão e Acessibilidade 2025](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/cia/issue/current): Current issue of III Congress on Inclusion and Accessibility 2025 proceedings

## Student Publications

- [Perg@minho - Revista Discente de História](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/perg): Student-led history journal from UFPB's History Teaching Laboratory
- [v. 1 n. 1 (2025)](https://periodicos.ufpb.br/index.php/perg/issue/current): First issue of Perg@minho student history journal launched in 2025
